kv_bytes_per_token.note: Formula-derived estimate (not a published figure); the layer mix is uncertain. config.json (primary, used here) shows alternating 128/4 compression ratios, giving about 4 GB per 1M tokens at FP8 (about 4 KB/token). Secondary blog summaries say a 3:1 CSA:HCA mix, giving about 11.6 GB per 1M tokens at BF16 (about 12 KB/token). The paper states roughly 2% of a BF16 GQA-8/d128 baseline (about 5 KB/token).
